# SmartHomeLightControl

**Class:** `SmartHomeLightControl` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A light's on/off, brightness, colour temperature, colour and presets

## Overview

@brief Light control widget A switch for on/off, sliders for brightness and colour temperature, a colour picker for RGB lights and a row of colour presets.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement> CreateSmartHomeLightControlElement();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
SmartHomeLightControl(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
SmartHomeLightControl(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeLightControl(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
